executive_summary: Getinge delivered record-level performance in 2021 with 4.1% organic sales growth to SEK 27 billion, driven by exceptional pandemic-related demand for ventilators and ECMO equipment. Adjusted EBITA reached SEK 5,211 M (19.3% margin). Strategic acquisitions including Talis Clinical and Irasun expanded digital and ECMO capabilities. Capital Markets Day in November established new financial targets for 2022-2025. Successfully completed remediation measures under FDA Consent Decree at Hechingen, Germany. SBTi commitment signed for net-zero emissions by 2035.
key_highlights: Net sales SEK 27 billion, up 4.1% organically
Adjusted EBITA SEK 5,211 M with 19.3% margin
Talis Clinical LLC acquisition - high acuity cloud-based software
Irasun GmbH acquisition (post year-end) - ECMO therapy and cardiac surgery
FDA Consent Decree remediation completed at Hechingen site
Capital Markets Day established new 2022-2025 financial targets
SBTi commitment signed for net-zero emissions by 2035
Customer satisfaction NPS improved to 39 from 27 in 2018

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: Average annual organic growth in net sales: 4-6%
Average adjusted earnings per share growth: >10%
Dividend policy to pay dividends of 30-50% of net profit
Become CO2 neutral in own operations by 2025

challenges.challenge: Global supply chain problems with component shortages and logistical difficulties
Pandemic uncertainty impacting customer access and demand patterns
FDA Consent Decree still ongoing despite progress at Hechingen

honesty_signals: Acknowledges supply chain challenges managed through employee dedication
Discusses FDA Consent Decree progress transparently
Notes future remains difficult to predict
Provides balanced view of pandemic impact on different segments

key_quotes.quote: We demonstrated great resilience during 2021, which is reflected in our excellent sales growth

Together with our customers and suppliers, we are now working to create an improved work environment for healthcare staff with products that simplify their work, lead to increased productivity and save more lives
The future ahead remains difficult to predict, but we will likely continue to be faced with the global challenges that we experienced in 2022 some way into the new year

questions_addressed: Can you tell us more about how strategy work is progressing?
What progress has Getinge made in terms of meeting customer needs?
Have customer relationships changed in the past year?
What progress has been made in sustainability?
What is your view of the future?

key_narratives: Exceptional pandemic-driven demand for ventilators and ECMO equipment in Acute Care Therapies
Strategic acquisition agenda accelerating with Talis Clinical and planned Irasun acquisition
Quality strategy implementation progressing with Hechingen FDA remediation complete
Sustainability framework established with SBTi commitment
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management views 2021 as successful strategy execution year despite pandemic challenges. Progress on quality remediation, digital offerings and sustainability position company for long-term growth. New financial targets for 2022-2025 demonstrate confidence.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Continued strong demand for ventilators and ECMO therapy. Rotaflow II launched in select markets. Talis Clinical acquisition expands digital offering. Expect normalization as pandemic subsides.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Strong growth in sterile transfer and bioreactors supporting vaccine manufacturing. DPTE-BetaBag production started in US. New bioreactor preparation system launched.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Comeback following extremely tough 2020. Order intake increased indicating higher sales ahead. Torin AI and VisioNIR launched. Verrix acquisition strengthens consumables.

operational_highlights: Talis Clinical LLC acquisition for high acuity cloud-based software
Irasun GmbH acquisition completed post year-end for ECMO therapy
DPTE-BetaBag US production started in Merrimack
Rotaflow II ECLS system launched in select markets
